description: This file defines the 'Section' class for Drupal's layout builder module, representing a layout section with components, settings, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a layout section with components, settings, and rendering capabilities in Drupal's layout builder.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Section with layout ID, settings, components, and third-party settings.

methods.name: toRenderArray
methods.description: Generates a renderable array for the section, including components and layout.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout plugin instance for this section.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout plugin ID.

methods.name: getLayoutSettings
methods.description: Returns the layout plugin settings.

methods.name: setLayoutSettings
methods.description: Sets the layout plugin settings.

methods.name: getDefaultRegion
methods.description: Returns the default region name of the layout.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Returns all components of the section.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component by UUID.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Adds a component to the section.

methods.name: removeComponent
methods.description: Removes a component by UUID.

methods.name: appendComponent
methods.description: Appends a component to a region.

methods.name: getNextHighestWeight
methods.description: Calculates the next highest weight in a region.

methods.name: getComponentsByRegion
methods.description: Returns components in a specific region, sorted by weight.

methods.name: insertAfterComponent
methods.description: Inserts a component after a specified component UUID.

methods.name: insertComponent
methods.description: Inserts a component at a specific delta position.

methods.name: layoutPluginManager
methods.description: Provides the layout plugin manager service.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the section to an array for storage.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a Section object from an array.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Performs a deep clone of the section, cloning components.

methods.name: getThirdPartySetting
methods.description: Retrieves a third-party setting value.

methods.name: getThirdPartySettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a provider.

methods.name: setThirdPartySetting
methods.description: Sets a third-party setting.

methods.name: unsetThirdPartySetting
methods.description: Removes a third-party setting.

methods.name: getThirdPartyProviders
methods.description: Returns all third-party providers.

methods.name: contextHandler
methods.description: Provides the context handler service.
